notes.title: Open Playtest for a new game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30509290/de4a6ffe25c66bcfbb293a86efff23bdf14bbd41.png[/img]

Hi everyone! I’m developing a 2D platformer called Bony Odyssey, and I’m getting ready for its release on Steam. I’d love to invite you to join the playtest and help make the game even better with your feedback!

What is the game about?
You play as a skeleton on a journey to find his missing animals. Expect fast-paced platforming, combat with skill-based upgrades, and a gothic cartoon art style.

I’m particularly interested in how the game feels to play—what you like, what frustrates you, and what you think is missing.

This isn’t the final version, and I’ll be expanding and improving the game based on player feedback.

How to join?
Playtest link on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858790/Bony_Odyssey/?l=english

If you try the game, please leave a few words about your impressions on the discussions page—it would really help improve the game! I’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback.
